verified_metadata.title: Climate change and Health; Predicting allergic and non-allergic respiratory diseases outbreaks in correlation with air pollution by leveraging Artificial Intelligence in Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries
verified_metadata.abstract:
Rationale
 Climate change is global concern that affects incidence and prevalence of many diseases including both residual and imported infections. Air alteration and harsh climate change directly affects health and quality of life , causing/exacerbating lung diseases and related allergies across the globe. There is an unmet need to analyze the large scale air quality (pollution) data in correlation with disease burden in GCC countries to prepare prediction models for forecasting the pollution and associated diseases. Methods
 Here we hypothesize that the monitoring, analyzing, and predicting the respiratory disease burden in correlation with air quality and climate change in GCC countries is one of the effective solutions for tackling the air quality related problems. We will leverage the historical and present big data for building a reliable respiratory disease prediction model by employing state-of-the-art machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques. Results
 Expected outcome: The proposed study will build an automated data integration from different resources (climate, air pollution, meteorological and disease data in GCC countries) to one platform and from there would be used for building models and correlation analysis for forecasting the air quality in correlation with respiratory diseases in the specified regions. Conclusions
 Based on the air quality prediction and pollution source analysis, it would be of great practical significance to make full use of meteorological conditions to coordinate the relationship between air quality and respiratory disease prevalence. Especially during major events and heavy pollution emergencies, timely and accurate air quality prediction and pollution source analysis can provide a decision-making basis for management departments.
